answer: Faking a thousand sybils means paying that stake for each, a cost far exceeding any reward, so the cheat collapses like a canyon wall. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a slow-moving reputation ledger, like ice carving a glacier valley: identity weight accrues only through verified work over many epochs. Honest agents earn reputation steadily across their voyage, making forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
